top_stories.title: PPFAS Mutual Fund introduces choti SIP in Parag Parikh Flexi Cap, Large Cap and 3 other schemes - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Parag Parikh Mutual Fund** has introduced a new "Choti SIP" facility for its five equity funds, allowing first-time investors to invest in mutual funds with a minimum of Rs 250 per installment.  The fund house also announced changes to the Systematic Transfer Plan (STP) processing frequency, effective May 21, 2026, to only process on business days. The changes are part of an addendum to the Statement of Additional Information (SAI) and Scheme Information Documents (SIDs) for the affected schemes.

top_stories.title: 'A long-term strategic failure': Three months in, is Trump losing the war on Iran? - World - DAWN.COM
top_stories.rephrased_article: **President Donald Trump** faces growing doubts about the success of his military campaign against **Iran**, despite initial tactical victories.  Analysts argue that the conflict has morphed into a protracted strategic failure, with Iran's resilience and continued support for proxy groups posing significant challenges to US objectives. While **Trump** maintains control over options on the table, he faces domestic pressure over rising gasoline prices and low approval ratings, making his position increasingly precarious. The crisis continues with no clear path to resolution, leaving experts predicting a grim post-war outlook for **Trump**.

top_stories.title: Israel attacks southern Lebanon and near Syrian border despite ‘ceasefire’ | Israel attacks Lebanon News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Israel** launched new air strikes in Lebanon on Saturday, targeting areas near the Syrian border and several villages in southern Lebanon.  The attacks followed earlier raids that killed 10 people and came despite a ceasefire announced by **President Donald Trump** on April 16. The attacks have caused widespread displacement and fear among residents, with many fleeing their homes due to forced evacuation orders issued by **Israel's military**.  Lebanon’s Health Ministry reported over 3,100 deaths since the escalation of Israeli attacks in March.

top_stories.title: Fraudster trying to sell fake ancient statues to Sotheby’s foiled over bogus invoices | Crime | The Guardian
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Andrew Crowley**, 46, was sentenced to a two-year suspended sentence for attempting to defraud **Sotheby’s** by selling fake ancient statues.  Crowley presented forged invoices claiming the statues were from 1976 and used printing methods that were 25 years too modern. Forensic analysis revealed the documents were fabricated, and the judge acknowledged Crowley did not intend to deceive but instead believed he inherited the items legitimately. **Sotheby’s** experts identified inconsistencies in the paperwork early on, preventing a potential fraud.

top_stories.title: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio four-day India visit updates - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio** arrived in New Delhi on Saturday (May 23, 2026) for his first official visit to India, aiming to recalibrate bilateral relations that have faced headwinds since mid-last year.  He met with **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and attended a meeting of the Quad Foreign Ministers. The trip comes after a period of strain between the two countries following trade disputes and President Donald Trump's statements regarding the India-Pakistan conflict.  The visit will focus on strengthening ties in areas such as energy, trade, investment, technology, and people-to-people exchanges, with discussions also expected to cover the West Asia crisis and its economic impact.

top_stories.title: London stabbing: Five men rushed to hospital after violent altercation, one arrested - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Five men** were injured in a stabbing incident on **Horn Lane** in Acton, London, after a violent altercation.  **Metropolitan Police** responded to reports of multiple men being assaulted and stabbed at around 2:47 pm, with all five victims taken to the hospital. A suspect, aged 26, was arrested for grievous bodily harm (GBH) and drug possession. **London Ambulance Service** dispatched multiple emergency teams to the scene.  Police are investigating the incident and have increased security in the area.

top_stories.title: Nifty stays range-bound as resistance near 23,800 caps upside move - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **India VIX** cooled off, declining 4.68% to 17.91 for the week. The **Nifty** index closed with a net gain of 75.80 points (+0.32%), but remains below a crucial resistance zone near 23,800-23,850.  While recent volatility has stabilized, traders should monitor the index's behavior near this level and avoid aggressive buying until it decisively breaks above. The **Nifty Metal Index** is showing relative strength, while other sectors like Midcap 100 and Energy are also performing well.

top_stories.title: Govt reduces petrol, high-speed diesel prices by Rs6 - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
top_stories.rephrased_article: **The government** reduced the price of petrol by Rs6 per litre and high-speed diesel (HSD) by Rs6.80 on Friday, bringing the price of petrol to Rs403.78 per litre and HSD to Rs402.78. **The Petroleum Division** announced the new prices would be effective from May 23rd, marking the second consecutive week of fuel price reductions.  This decision comes after a period of fluctuating prices following the US-Israeli war on Iran in February. The government has been adjusting petroleum prices weekly since then, aiming to balance global market fluctuations and domestic needs.

top_stories.title: UK, German and French aid cuts will take ‘devastating toll’ on most vulnerable, says study | Global development | The Guardian
top_stories.rephrased_article: A new report by the Barcelona Institute for Global Health (ISGlobal) warns that cuts to foreign aid budgets by **the UK, France**, and **Germany** could contribute to over 11.5 million preventable deaths by the end of the decade. The report estimates that **UK** cuts alone could result in 5.1 million additional deaths by 2030, while **France's** reductions could lead to 3.5 million and **Germany's** to almost 2.9 million. The report highlights the detrimental impact of these cuts on global health systems, particularly in low- and middle-income countries, and emphasizes the need for predictable and multi-sourced financing to ensure a robust international system.

top_stories.title: Delhi Police files supplementary chargesheet in Parliament breach case - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **Delhi Police Special Cell** filed a nearly 14,000-page supplementary chargesheet against the accused in the 2023 Parliament security breach case. The chargesheet, submitted before the Patiala House Court, includes allegations of terrorist acts, criminal conspiracy, and provocation to cause riots under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA).  The prosecution argued that the filing was appropriate given ongoing proceedings on framing of charges, while defense counsel objected, arguing it was an abuse of process. The court directed a hard copy be supplied to the defense counsel and listed the matter for further scrutiny on May 29th.
